messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: alert triggered for service `inference-hosted-prod` - Pager: pagerduty@redwood.com - urgency: high. Incident ID: INC-2498765432
Emma (SRE): I just got the PD page. But the PD web UI shows the service bound to `billing-prod`?
Dan (Oncall): I saw the phone ring and the notification said `billing-prod` as well. I haven't touched schedules.
Raj (Eng-Infra): Heads up - we rolled a small schedule change 35m ago to add contractors to billing rotation. Might be related.
Maria (Support): Customers on hosted inference are reporting timeouts in the last 2m. I have one support ticket with logs.
Emma (SRE): ok quick triage: is the alert rule pointing to the right PD service or did the service mapping flip?
Raj (Eng-Infra): looking... in our infra repo the PD binding for alert group `inference-latency` points to `svc_inference` (id: svc-7788) still. But PD shows `billing-prod` because of service tag collisions in the PD UI.
Dan (Oncall): can we silence the noisy pages while we fix routing? I can ack but we need to stop firing to the wrong team.
Emma (SRE): Dan acked in PD?
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: alert INC-2498765432 acknowledged by Dan (Oncall). Escalation paused.
Emma (SRE): Good. Maria, can you confirm customer impact severity? Any SLOs breached?
Maria (Support): two customers hit 5xx on generation endpoints, not widespread yet. One on EU region, one us-west. No SLA breaches yet but latency >5s.
Raj (Eng-Infra): Quick theory: PD service lookup uses `service_key` + `integration` metadata. During the schedule update we accidentally added a `tag: inference-prod` to the billing schedule object which PD uses for fallback routing. That would route inference alerts to billing.
Emma (SRE): if that's true we need to remove the tag in PD and rebind the alert rule to the correct service id. Who can patch PD? Raj?
Raj (Eng-Infra): I can. I'm going to run the PD api to remove the tag from the billing schedule and rebind the alert. Patch plan: 1) remove tag from `billing-prod` 2) rebind `inference-latency` to `svc_inference` 3) un-silence alerts after verification.
Emma (SRE): Call out exact commands so we can audit.
Raj (Eng-Infra): running:
```
curl -X DELETE "https://api.pagerduty.com/tags/billing-prod:inference-prod" \
 -H "Authorization: Token token=$PD_TOKEN" \
 -H "Accept: application/vnd.pagerduty+json;version=2"
```
and
```
curl -X PUT "https://api.pagerduty.com/services/svc-7788" \
 -H "Authorization: Token token=$PD_TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"service": {"escalation_policy": "ep-1234"}}'
```
(placeholder, will run via CI with creds)
Dan (Oncall): I can hold ack and monitor, please ping here when fixed. I'll also create a short PD override to prevent further spillover to billing.
Emma (SRE): Maria - notify affected customers that we're investigating and it's isolated to alert routing for now. Provide ETA ~20m.
Maria (Support): on it. Drafting message: "We're investigating intermittent timeouts on hosted inference; targeted mitigation underway. We'll update within 20 minutes"
Raj (Eng-Infra): done the PD tag delete in staging and verifying. If tests pass, I'll run in prod in 2 mins.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: service tag `inference-prod` removed from `billing-prod` (audit user: raj).
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: service `inference-latency` now bound to `svc-7788` (svc_inference).
Emma (SRE): Nice. Dan, can you unack and force a test alert to validate routing?
Dan (Oncall): sending test.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: test alert for `inference-latency` routed to `svc_inference` and notified oncall Dan (Oncall).
Dan (Oncall): I got it, correct routing.
Maria (Support): customers updated. One replied "thanks". No new errors from first impacted customers.
Emma (SRE): Actions: (1) postmortem to explain how schedule tags are used for PD routing, (2) add automated check in CI that prevents non-inference tags on billing schedules, (3) run audit of all services for tag collisions. Raj please create follow-ups.
Raj (Eng-Infra): will create follow-ups: GH issue and PD audit runbook.
Emma (SRE): Final: re-enable alerts to normal cadence, remove temporary overrides.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: alerting cadence restored.
Emma (SRE): closing incident thread. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
Maria (Support): thanks team.
Dan (Oncall): closing my oncall handoff note: marked as handled.
